title: Zwift Rider Spots ‘A Guy Taking a Dump’ in New Real-World Video Package
content:
Zwift rushes to remove images of a figure squatting in the roadside bushes from its new premium 'Plus' world after user post goes viral.

Read the full article at Zwift Rider Spots ‘A Guy Taking a Dump’ in New Real-World Video Package on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
